errors.text: The proposed intervention is severe plastic deformation followed by partial recrystallization, rather than the target hexahedron-anvil HPHT treatment at 6 GPa and 1473 K for 2 hours.
The proposed 600–750 °C annealing and >1.5 GPa deformation conditions do not reconstruct the target pressure-temperature-time window.
The HIP comparison does not isolate extreme pressure because pressure, temperature, deformation history, and recrystallization state all differ between the two sample sets.
The hypothesis assumes that recrystallization will generate coherent FCC/B2 interfaces or nanotwins without direct evidence that this occurs in Al0.7CoCrFeNi.
